jam.name: 2026 Epic AI MegaJam
jam.theme: DIRECTOR'S CUT (Your vision, your edits, your final cut.)
jam.deadline_local: Sunday Nov 15, 5:59 PM Pacific / 8:59 PM Eastern
facts: Unreal Engine or UEFN only; teams of up to five or solo; any AI tools allowed, no limit on agents

$65,000 in cash prizes: Best Overall $7,500 / $5,000 / $2,500, plus Solo Driver, Best Team, Render Royalty, Pocket Powerhouse, Glass Box and Walkie-Talkie categories, and continuation grants up to $50,000
submissions closed on Sunday Nov 15 and late ones were disqualified; a judging panel scores entries 1 to 5; winners are announced by January 29, 2027
Hollywoodland was one of the entries: a whole browser MMO made during the jam, which most people find hard to believe; it has kept being updated since

topics.text: GTA VI comes out Thursday, November 19. Base consoles reportedly run it at 30 fps; the PS5 Pro gets ray-traced shadows. Half the internet has booked the day off.
Zelda: Ocarina of Time came to Switch 2 on November 5 with a modern overhaul and is reported to be Nintendo's fastest-selling Switch 2 game.
World of Warcraft: Forever launched on PC on November 4. Pikmin 4 and Metaphor: ReFantazio got Switch 2 versions this week. A new Wolfenstein is confirmed in production.
Nvidia's Jensen Huang stepped down as CEO this week after 33 years, with the CFO as interim chief; Nvidia stock sold off and earnings are due within days.
Anthropic's IPO is expected to start trading November 19 (ticker ANT). OpenAI closed $11 billion of a funding round, less than it wanted. People argue about whether AI is a bubble.

New AI models this month: Claude Fable 5.2, Google's Gemini 4 Hydrogen, OpenAI's Images 2.6. Nonprofits sued five big AI labs asking a court to freeze advanced model work, and eight US states sued OpenAI over ChatGPT safety claims.
Microsoft had a global outage this week (Outlook, Teams, Copilot) after a network upgrade went wrong. claude.ai was also down for a while on November 13.

The war with Iran is still going: Iran said it destroyed a US radar in Bahrain and hit navigation systems in Oman in answer to US strikes. Oil prices are jumpy. People are split on whether the US should be there at all.

The FAA ordered a rare nationwide ground stop on US flights and then lifted it; the transportation secretary blamed ageing hardware and officials said there was no sign of a cyberattack. Travellers were stranded for hours.
The United States has officially lost its measles elimination status after 26 years: more than 5,400 cases and 10 deaths in 2026. The vaccine argument is everywhere again.
A tanker hit a docked paddlewheel cruise boat on the Mississippi in New Orleans; the boat sank, more than 30 people were hurt, nobody died.
After the US midterms, Alaska elected a Democratic governor for the first time since 1998, in a ranked-choice count. People are still arguing about what the midterms mean.
Mercedes clinched the 2026 Formula 1 constructors' championship. At the WTA Finals, Svitolina beat Sabalenka in three sets to reach the semi-finals.
Godzilla Minus Zero has been top of the US box office.
